rationale: No plain in-repo call to tuple_variant exists. The only invocation is the quote! template in serde_derive that #[derive(Deserialize)] expands into the test suite's types. test_suite/tests/test_annotations.rs:2738 and test_enum_internally_tagged.rs:564 explicitly note that their tests reach private::de::content::VariantDeserializer::tuple_variant (via FlatMapDeserializer/ContentDeserializer).
